correctness.rationale: With probability-normalized Haar or grid measure, expanding |P|^4 retains exactly ordered quadruples a,b,c,d whose vector a+b−c−d is zero, or zero modulo the grid order, with weight ε_a ε_b ε_c ε_d. This also gives the two contraction formulas by first grouping sums or differences. Independently enumerated all 8^4 quadruples, compressed their weights by the parity mask of the four indices, and evaluated the resulting integer sums on all 256 sign assignments for moduli 3,4,5 and on the integer lattice. All three histogram rows agree entry by entry (hence the minima, maxima and their counts). Values modulo 5 and on the integer lattice agree mask by mask. Analytically, two pair sums in [−2,2]^2 cannot collide modulo any n≥5 unless equal, proving all-orders stabilization for every mask. For the continuous moment I independently enumerated the entire group as the eight signed coordinate permutations, each combined with the eight sign/checkerboard modulations. Both types preserve |P|^4 averages (or permute the convolutions up to signs). The enumeration found 13 orbits, with exactly two minimum-88 orbits represented by `----+-+-` (8) and `----++-+` (16) in the frozen order. For n≥3 the eight characters are distinct, so the zero-displacement autocorrelation is 8 and the two quoted merit factors follow from 64/(M−64). The independent replay is `python3 /workspace/branches/review_replay.py 2`; the frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Exact only for fixed unit binary signs at the eight outer cells; the aperiodic optimizer equivalence is not asserted for odd sampled grids or arbitrary phase alphabets.

value.rationale: The centrally deleted square is the symmetric one-erasure case of the natural 3×3 Fourier array. The invariant quantifies precisely how sampling changes the entire binary energy spectrum: order three lowers the attainable minimum, while order four has the same minimum as the stabilized problem but different optimizer multiplicities and intermediate energies. Hence the aliased census shows effects invisible from the known aperiodic extrema and serves as an exact benchmark for finite-grid versus continuous aperture calculations.
residual_risks: Small exact benchmark, not a claim of general optimization or classification for other erasures or alphabets.
